tools.name: list_coverages
tools.description: List the insurance coverages Alishahi Insurance quotes, with a link to each coverage's page.

tools.name: get_quote_questions
tools.description: Get the questions to ask for one coverage (names, types and allowed choices). All are optional.

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Send the person's quote request to Sam Alishahi, a licensed independent insurance broker, who will contact them. Only call after the person has confirmed they want to be contacted.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Read a quote application Sam Alishahi started from the person's email: every field, its allowed choices, what's filled in and what's still required. The application_id and token are in Sam's reply email (Reference APP-<id>).

tools.name: complete_application
tools.description: Send the person's answers for an application Sam Alishahi started. Only send what the person told you or confirmed; leave unknown fields out. Returns the updated application with any rejected answers and why.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_application · Private data: submit_quote_request, get_application · Public sink: submit_quote_request, get_application, complete_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_application · Private data: submit_quote_request, get_application · Public sink: submit_quote_request, get_application, complete_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
